Arjun (ML Eng): heads up — after converting a HF chat model for dedicated infra, tool-calls sometimes return malformed JSON when running the 4-bit quantized build. payloads are being split across tokens and the tool parser chokes. :thinking:
Maya (Applied ML): ugh. do you have a tiny repro or the sequence that triggers it?
Arjun (ML Eng): minimal repro below — happens consistently when the model sees the tool sentinel + role tokens back-to-back. i suspect special-token id collisions after conversion.
Arjun (ML Eng): ```
# user thread content (what we send to the model)
[
  {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
  {"role":"user","content":"Call tool: search(query=\"inference cost\")"},
  {"role":"tool","name":"search","content":"3 results..."}
]
```
Arjun (ML Eng): my model config snippet: 
```json
{"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","additional_special_tokens":["<|tool|>","<|json_start|>","<|json_end|>","<|role_user|>"]}
```
Maya (Applied ML): can you paste tokenizer.encode of the tool sequence? i want to see token ids around the sentinels.
Arjun (ML Eng): sure — `tokenizer.encode('<|tool|><|json_start|>{"name":"search"}', add_special_tokens=False)` -> `[12, 87, 12, 203, 9, ...]` — note the repeated 12 where i expected distinct ids.
Lee (Token Ops): that explains it — looks like HF tokenizer merged one of the tags into the other during BPE merges. when two special tokens are substrings or their byte sequences overlap, the tokenizer can end up mapping both to the same token id unless they were registered as separate specials before training.
Sam (Infra): is this specific to quantized run? or same on FP16?
Arjun (ML Eng): FP16 behaves fine; only reproducible on the quantized conversion path that uses our converter binary. suspect converter's special-token handling step is lossy.
Nina (Research): quantization shouldn't change tokenization, but converter could be stripping or reserializing the tokenizer vocabulary in a way that collapses entries. we saw similar with model-onboard v0.9 where merge rules were flattened.
CI Bot: failed job: <https://ci.redwood.dev/ci/12345|onboard-converter-1853> :skull:
Maya (Applied ML): quick mitigations: 1) ensure `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'additional_special_tokens': [...]})` is called before saving the converted tokenizer, 2) run `tokenizer.save_pretrained(...)` and diff the vocab and merges files, 3) for immediate safety strip role tags before tokenization and re-insert as strings post-decode (hacky).
Sam (Infra): i can patch the converter to preserve special token indices if you point me to the failing serialization step. maybe our protobuf/JSON serializer collapses duplicates.
Lee (Token Ops): longer-term we should add a lint to the HF->Redwood conversion that checks for: 
- duplicate token ids in special token sets
- substring overlap between special tokens
- tokens that collide with common punctuation-triggered merges
and fail the conversion with a clear error.
Nina (Research): also add an eval in onboarding harness: send a set of synthetic tool-calls (random tool names + JSON payloads) through the model with quantization flags on and assert that `parse_tool_output()` recovers the original JSON exactly. call it `toolcall-sentinel-e2e`.
Arjun (ML Eng): agree. for this model i patched the conversion locally by forcing unique sentinel tokens like `<|r_tool_01|>` instead of generic `<|tool|>` and that fixed the collision.
Maya (Applied ML): gonna add a checklist item to the onboarding doc: "verify special token uniqueness + add e2e toolcall eval on quantized conversion". i'll open a PR for the converter linter and the onboarding test.
Sam (Infra): ping me on the PR, i'll add a test that runs the converter binary in a container and checks the tokenizer files.
Lee (Token Ops): also document a short guidance for model owners: prefer long, non-overlapping sentinel tokens (no common substrings), or prefix them with a reserved namespace, e.g. `<|rw_tool::search|>`.
Maya (Applied ML): thanks everyone. follow-ups: @Sam please link failing CI job in the PR, @Nina can you add the e2e test spec, @Lee can you draft the linter rules. i'll own the onboarding checklist change. :thumbsup:
